summary: NSTAR Electric Co. (Eversource Energy) filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement registering a $700M debt offering of $350M 4.650% debentures due 2031 and $350M 5.200% debentures due 2036. The filing is a routine shelf takedown; no special situation is triggered. Terms include public offering prices near par, semi-annual interest, and redemption features. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten by Goldman Sachs, Mizuho, TD Securities, US Bancorp, and Wells Fargo. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation event is present; this is purely a capital-markets debt issuance.
